Hi A, it all depends on which scale we are working from and how we
drill down. Price will bounce from FL to FL, so if you have space after a
 reaction to your FL, I agree. A master here a while ago (cant remember
who) stated that they have no bias. Meaning they have areas on the same
chart where they will sell, hit an opposing TG and if they get PA they
will go long. So, You may have a buy. I dont TT at the moment so I
would have liked to see price retrace back to your FL. prior to a EG
into space. Also is your MPL kink also a LFL, meaning has it taken out
an opposing UFL.

Thanks for stopping by my friend. Welcome anytime. These questions are very valid

author: Edge
text:
A member PMd me asking a question on how I choose the levels. They
referenced my last post. To me we all need to answer this by going back
to the PAR article. Its all there in half a page. I know that even the
masters are not carbon copies of each other. How Harry trades differs to
 Salivan which differs to Mertch who all even differ to even IF.

But you know what brings them all together? Its the foundations that can
 be witnessed in Price Approach Reaction. For me I look for a Big
picture, where price is going and come from. I find the LFL/UFL kinks I
want to trade, then I drill down and find all the order blocks and look
for confluence with a trick, PCP or SR kinks. LS being the most strong
**I NEED TO SEE CLEAN ORDERS**. I even drill further to find more kinks
and ensure its a UFL/LFL that has taken opposing area in its formation. I
 then decide where its come from and whether we have PA, or can I TT
based on the other factors and the approach. IE are retailers getting in
 early and being trapped.

I have been spending a lot of time with a few of my close friends
undertaking analysis and some trading, so I don't get to post as much in
 my journal as I would like.

What works for me, may not work for others, so take it with a grain of salt
